name: Su Nuraxi di Barumini
description: Rising from the farmland of southern Sardinia near the town of Barumini, Su Nuraxi is a Bronze Age stone fortress begun around the 17th century BC. A central tower, ringed by four corner towers, stands above the foundations of a village that was lived in for roughly a thousand years. You can climb inside the tower's dark, beehive-roofed chambers and wander the maze of ancient stone huts below.
